relation_to_idea.conceptual_difference: This work proposes an unrestricted multi-hop reasoning network for interpretable KGQA. Our idea enriches training triples with local context subgraphs from the same passage and adds an adaptive repair loop for one-hop failures, focusing on training data enrichment and iterative correction rather than designing a specific reasoning network architecture.
